description:
Prove and keep foreground `spawn` as a blocking tool that is not part of orchestration groups.

## Background

Existing callers use spawn for fan-out-and-wait. Changing its return type would break that. Share the runner internally but await all children before returning.

## Files

- `packages/pi-minions/src/tools/spawn.ts`
- `packages/pi-minions/src/spawn/*`
- existing spawn tests

## Behavior

- Keep `agent` selector.
- Still Promise.allSettled (or equivalent wait) before return.
- Nodes kind=spawn; excluded from orchestrated snapshots and packets.
- While spawn is in flight the parent turn is blocked; orchestrated packets wait as followUp (Pi behavior).
- Spawn children get inspection allowlist, not comm tools.

## Success criteria

- Existing spawn tests pass.
- list_minions can distinguish spawn vs orchestrated.
- A running spawn child is absent from orchestrate fleet snapshots.

## Test plan

- Existing unit/integration spawn tests.
- Regression: spawn + orchestrate in the same tree; snapshot filter.

## Considerations

Do not add required description to spawn. Do not add taskType to spawn in V1 unless it is optional and ignored for packets (spawn does not emit packets).


## Test plan (expanded)

- Existing spawn tests still pass.
- list/tree snapshot: running spawn child absent from orchestrated fleet.
- Spawn child tools: inspection yes, comm no, close no.
- Logging: kind=spawn, groupId empty/undefined.
title: Keep foreground spawn blocking and outside orchestrated fleets
